children: WASHINGTON (dpa-AFX) - United Airlines Holdings, Inc. (UAL) released earnings for its third quarter that Increases, from last year
The company's bottom line totaled $1.029 billion, or $3.14 per share.  This compares with $949 million, or $2.90 per share, last year.
Excluding items, United Airlines Holdings, Inc. reported adjusted earnings of $833 million or $2.54 per share for the period.
The company's revenue for the period rose 17.4% to $17.875 billion from $15.225 billion last year.
United Airlines Holdings, Inc. earnings at a glance (GAAP) :
United expects Q4 total operating revenue growth to accelerate versus Q3 and set another record with an over 20% year-over-year increase
